description: Routes each model request to the cheapest capable model: a local Ollama model for routine work, a cloud model only when needed.
configuration.title: Kete Models
configuration.ollama.endpoint: Address of the Ollama server used for local models. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace can't redirect model traffic.
configuration.ollama.model: Ollama model that Kete Auto uses for routine requests, for example `qwen2.5-coder:7b`. When empty, the first model Ollama lists is used.
configuration.ollama.requestTimeout: Seconds to wait for a local model to start responding before giving up and trying the next model. The wait covers loading the model and reading the whole prompt, so a slow or shared machine needs more than the default. It cannot exceed 290: Node's networking stack ends the request at 300 seconds regardless. A server that needs longer than that for an agent prompt is too slow for local agent work — use a cloud tier, a smaller model, or faster hardware.
configuration.cloud.enabled: Allow Kete Auto to send requests to a cloud model when a request needs it and an API key is set. When disabled, only local models are used. Can only be set in user settings.
configuration.cloud.vendor: Cloud vendor Kete Auto tries first. The other is used when the first has no API key, has no model for the tier, or is unreachable. Both vendors' models stay available in the model picker.
configuration.cloud.vendor.openai: OpenAI, or any endpoint that speaks its chat completions format.
configuration.openai.endpoint: Address of the OpenAI-compatible API used for OpenAI models, including the version path. Point it at another server — Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, vLLM, LM Studio — to use that instead. Can only be set in user settings, so a workspace can't redirect model traffic.
configuration.openai.midModel: OpenAI model used for the mid tier, for example `gpt-5-mini`. Model names change, so check what your account or server actually serves.
configuration.openai.frontierModel: OpenAI model used for the frontier tier, for example `gpt-5-codex`. Model names change, so check what your account or server actually serves.
configuration.routing.maxTier: Most expensive tier Kete Auto may use. Requests that would need a higher tier use the highest allowed one instead.
configuration.routing.maxTier.local: Local models only; nothing is sent to the cloud.
configuration.routing.maxTier.mid: Up to the mid tier (Claude Haiku 4.5, or the OpenAI mid model).
configuration.routing.frontierModel: Claude model used for the frontier tier. The OpenAI equivalent is `#kete.models.openai.frontierModel#`.
configuration.routing.localMaxInputToken: Estimated prompt size, in tokens, above which Kete Auto moves a request from the local model to the mid tier. It also sets the context length requested from Ollama.
configuration.routing.midMaxInputTokens: Estimated prompt size, in tokens, above which Kete Auto moves a request from the mid tier to the frontier tier.
